what: Photo·text rows (track) are appended until the strip length exceeds 1.5 times the screen width, and each row loops endlessly, moving left linearly by its own width (−100%) — gallery photo row 40s, ‹🔥HOT!› text band 18s. Refills when the window width changes

options.[data-fx-part=track]: One flowing row (direct child) — spacing between rows comes from padding inside the row (original photo row padding-left 30px, gap 30px)
options.--fx-dur: Duration to pass one set width, default 40s

from.where: index.html gallery photo row .n-gallery__items (40s, original .nc-top__gallery__items__list tickerLoop) · popular articles header “HOT!” band .n-popular__ticker (18s, original .label img tickerLoop)
